product.name: XAG P150 Max Agricultural Drone
product.description: A modular agricultural drone for autonomous spraying, spreading, field mapping, and farm logistics, with interchangeable task systems and precision navigation.

product.name: XAG P150 Agricultural Drone
product.description: A high-capacity agricultural drone for autonomous spraying, spreading, mapping, and transport across large fields and specialty-crop operations.

product.name: XAG P60 Agricultural Drone
product.description: A compact agricultural drone for precision spraying, granular spreading, and field mapping in small and medium-sized farms and specialty-crop applications.

product.name: XAG P100 Pro Agricultural Drone
product.description: An agricultural drone platform for aerial crop protection and field application tasks, including spraying and spreading.

product.name: XAG R100 Agricultural Rover
product.description: A compact electric agricultural rover for autonomous spraying and transport in greenhouses, orchards, and densely planted specialty crops.

product.name: XAG R200 Agricultural Rover
product.description: A larger electric agricultural rover for spraying and material transport in orchards, vineyards, and other wider-row specialty-crop environments.
